description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Product model within the Opencart admin catalog module. It contains methods for adding and editing products, including handling related data such as descriptions, categories, filters, options, attributes, SEO URLs, images, discounts, specials, rewards, layouts, downloads, related products, and subscriptions. The class extends a base system engine model and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on product data.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for managing products in the OpenCart admin catalog, providing methods to add and edit product data including descriptions, categories, filters, options, attributes, SEO URLs, images, discounts, specials, rewards, layouts, downloads, related products, and subscriptions.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for managing products in the OpenCart admin catalog, providing methods to add, edit, copy, and delete products and their related data.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for managing products in the OpenCart admin catalog, providing methods to add, edit, copy, delete, and retrieve product data and related associations.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product to the database along with its related data such as descriptions, categories, filters, images, etc., and returns the new product ID.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product's data and its related associations based on the provided product ID and data array.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Copies an existing product, creating a new product with overridden attributes based on the specified product ID.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product and all its related data, including descriptions, categories, discounts, images, and other associations.

methods.name: addVariant
methods.description: Creates a variant of a master product, overriding certain values.

methods.name: editVariant
methods.description: Updates a variant product with specific data, overriding its master product.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product and its related data based on the provided product ID and data array.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing product with optional data overrides.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product and all its associated data from the database.

methods.name: addVariant
methods.description: Creates a new product variant based on a master product, overriding specific data.

methods.name: editVariant
methods.description: Updates a product variant's data, overriding master product information.

methods.name: editVariants
methods.description: Edits multiple variants of a master product, recalculating override data from existing variants.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific product, including various related data, by product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on filter criteria, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific product.

methods.name: editMasterId
methods.description: Assigns or updates the master product ID of a specified product.

methods.name: addSpecial
methods.description: Inserts a new special price entry for a specific product, including customer group, priority, price, start/end dates.

methods.name: deleteSpecials
methods.description: Removes all special price entries associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Retrieves all special price entries for a given product, ordered by priority and price.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Inserts reward points for a product for a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Removes all reward points associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Fetches reward points for a particular product, returning an array indexed by customer group ID.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Associates a download ID with a product, linking the product to downloadable files.

methods.name: deleteDownloads
methods.description: Removes all download associations for a specific product.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves all download IDs linked to a product.

methods.name: getTotalDownloadsByDownloadId
methods.description: Counts total number of products associated with a particular download ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a product with a store ID, managing multi-store setups.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a given product.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a product.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a product with a specific layout in a store, based on store ID and layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a specific product.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all product-to-layout mappings for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all product-to-layout mappings associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves all layout configurations linked to a product, indexed by store ID.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many products are associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: addRelated
methods.description: Creates or toggles a related product relationship between two products, ensuring bidirectional links.

methods.name: deleteRelated
methods.description: Removes all related product links for a given product, both directions.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Fetches all product IDs related to the given product.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds subscription information for a product including customer group, subscription plan, trial price, and regular price.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptions
methods.description: Removes all subscription entries for a product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription records associated with a product.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionsBySubscriptionPlanId
methods.description: Deletes all subscription entries for the specified subscription plan ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionPlanId
methods.description: Returns the total number of products associated with a specific subscription plan ID.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports related to a specific product ID.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches a list of reports for a specific product, with pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total count of reports for a specific product.
